title: Shared definitions
description: Primitive types shared by every source and bundle schema. Every string that reaches the reader is plain text or inline Markdown; nothing here can carry markup, script or style.

apiVersion.description: Content contract version. The engine supports the current and the previous version.

id.description: A stable lower-case identifier: letters, digits and single hyphens.

chapterId.description: A chapter identifier, ch01 to ch99. It is also the chapter's URL segment.

variableKey.description: A reader variable key, such as HOST_LAN_IP. Written as <KEY> in code.

text.description: Plain text. Rendered as text, never as markup.

inlineMarkdown.description: Text with inline Markdown only: `code`, **bold**, *emphasis* and [links](#/...). Raw HTML is not allowed.

url.description: A link: an internal route (#/...), a same-page anchor (#...), a file in the bundle's lab/ tree (lab/...), https, or mailto. Every other scheme, including javascript: and data:, is rejected.

assetPath.description: A file in the program's assets folder, referenced relatively.

color.description: A colour token value: #rgb, #rrggbb or oklch(L C H).

tone.description: A colour ramp from the platform palette.

objectiveId.description: A skill objective id: chapter id, a dot, then a name.

exerciseName.description: A lab exercise name, as typed in `lab start NAME`.

dataRef.description: A key in the page's data file.

seoTitle.description: The title search engines and browser tabs show, written for what people search (about 50-65 characters).

seoDescription.description: The description search engines show under the title (about 120-160 characters).
